title: Genuine async forward writer transport

acceptance.description: Implement frozen async XmlWriter methods and IAsyncDisposable through additive partials with bounded WriteAsync transport, retained owners/cursors, operation+call tokens and guard across awaits; exact sync lexical/state/namespace semantics and leave-open abort.

Prove delayed async-only output, short bounded writes, equality across encoding/BOM/namespaces/escaping/text splits/indent, cancellation/reentrancy/errors/primary exception identity and exactly-once scratch release without synchronous I/O or Task.Run bridges.

Compile and demonstrate without later adapters; record compiled API, real buffered primitive/allocation-positive and setup/continuation/retained scratch evidence, preserve verified sync writer/earlier serialization and validate known revisions.
